title: 9 in 10 worries never came true 🤯 #shorts
description:
You worry. It doesn't happen. And your brain quietly takes the credit. 🧠 In one small study of people with generalized anxiety disorder, about 9 in 10 worries never came true.

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/ez-lXPY79pU
